title: Return errors from failed bus subscriptions in gateway startup
definitionOfDone: startBusTaps() returns error if any subscription fails
Gateway startup fails fast if bus subscriptions fail, OR health check reports degraded status

implementationPlan.description: Change `startBusTaps()` signature from `func (s *server) startBusTaps()` to `func (s *server) startBusTaps() error`. Collect errors from all 4 bus subscriptions (heartbeat, DLQ, sys.job.>, sys.audit.>). If any critical subscription fails (heartbeat or DLQ), return the error. For event taps (sys.job.>, sys.audit.>), log a warning but don't fail startup since they're optional for WS streaming.
Run `go test ./core/controlplane/gateway/...` to verify no regressions.
